title: Welcome To The Archives
introOne: In twain struck with judgement; like a prophecy, the blackened marble crown of the great city of Elû came crashing down. The library of Ikuisuus was no more.
introTwo: Yet when the Interlocking tore through the skein of the Hidden Kingdom, a hope was formed. Even if the fleeing moon and spiteful sun turned the archives to cinders, and Hiisi, once caged by the fleeing celestials, fell screaming through the cracks, a speck of ambition coalesced from the Chaos.
introThree: Now, deep within the Wound, far from where it once crowned the world, a new Ikuisuus stirs. Unfinished, half-sunken, malformed —yet it still glows with a grotesque beauty. With newfound ambition, the Archivist's dream to document the vile and beautiful lands of Damocles, may yet be caught.
